purpose: Shows a photo or illustration cropped to a fixed ratio on a muted placeholder, so layouts never shift while it loads. Ratio auto fills its parent.

notFor.case: A drop area for uploading pictures.

Default.meaning: Static; shown on Surface/muted while the media loads.
Default.visual: Surface/muted fill behind the media; Radius/none (square) or Radius/container (rounded).

a11y.role: img (alt is the accessible name; alt="" when decorative)

openQuestions: What shows when the media fails to load: the muted placeholder only, or an icon or message? No error look is designed.
